## Checklist

- [ ] The test commands in CONTRIBUTING.md pass locally.
- [ ] Cost or pricing changes include unit tests and a `docs/formulas.md` update.
- [ ] Runtime dependency changes include a `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` update.
- [ ] Schema changes append a migration and never edit the v1.0 baseline.
- [ ] No personal data, real names, or secrets in code, fixtures, or screenshots.
- [ ] Accessibility: keyboard and screen-reader behavior checked; `e2e/a11y.spec.ts` passes.
